style: Original illustrated devotional Indian epic; family-friendly cinematic storybook art, readable 16:9 framing, no imitation of a named studio.
global_rules: Gajendra and crocodile are normal quadruped/low-slung animal bodies until the narratively explicit divine transformation; no human mouth motion.
Indradyumna is Gajendra's former human birth; Huhu is crocodile's former Gandharva birth. Keep separate physical identities and preserve narrative revelation.
Narayana's four-arm iconography and Gajendra's later four-arm spiritual form must not mix identities or creature anatomy.
Trikuta three-peak silhouette and one lake land/water master geography remain stable.
Portraits, voice auditions and image refs are not approved until actual media hashes and reviewer decisions exist.
No blood, visible wounds, grotesque violence or inaccurate new creature anatomy.

GAJENDRA.design: Royal Indian elephant; natural quadruped body, strong trunk, consistent tusks and smaller Indian-elephant ears; no crown or human hands; unique distinctive brow/marking to separate from herd.
GAJENDRA.performance: Expresses effort/concern through natural behavior and prayer via inner voiceover, not lip-synced human mouth.

CROCODILE.design: Large realistic crocodile with constant scale, jaw profile, tail and grasping position; no cartoon grin or human lips.
CROCODILE.performance: Wild animal sounds and behavior, not villain monologues.

NARAYANA.design: Reverent original four-armed screen depiction of Vishnu/Narayana in yellow garments with recognizable conch, chakra, mace and lotus; stable crown and ornaments.
NARAYANA.performance: Gracious, urgent compassion; distinguish divine presence from spectacle.

GARUDA.design: Majestic golden-brown bird carrier with stable wings, beak and body geometry; large enough to bear Narayana.
GARUDA.performance: Noble flight and poised arrival; non-speaking unless source-reviewed adaptation later warrants narration.

HUHU.design: Gandharva king with consistent ornate attire and face; separate humanlike identity from CROCODILE body.
HUHU.performance: Playful and careless in flashback, then remorseful and grateful.

DEVALA.design: Sage in simple draped garment; mature face, hair and prayer-bead details stable.

INDRADYUMNA.design: Adult former king in hermitage: matted hair and austere forest attire; earlier kingship may appear only if scripted later.
INDRADYUMNA.performance: Silent devotional concentration and later calm acceptance, not action villain.

AGASTYA.design: Distinguished sage visiting with disciples; recognizable form and modest ascetic garments.
AGASTYA.performance: Insulted at lack of greeting; clear separate identity from DEVALA.

GAJENDRA_LIBERATED.design: Four-armed spiritual associate in yellow garments following sārūpya-mukti; visually distinct from quadrupedal GAJENDRA and not a mere anthropomorphic elephant.
